description: This false-colour infrared map displays a landscape featuring a prominent river (dark blue) traversing an area characterized by dense, actively photosynthesizing vegetation (bright red) and lighter-toned terrain (green/tan/brown). A yellow polygon highlights a specific land cover area, identified as "2.3.3 Land principally occupied by agriculture with significant areas of natural vegetation" according to the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) CLC+ (next-generation land cover/land use) nomenclature. Within this outlined polygon, several irregular, light-coloured patches, representing agricultural fields, are visible, intermingled with areas of red (dense natural vegetation) and lighter green/brown tones. The broader landscape shows bright red areas consistent with forests or dense shrubland, while lighter green/tan/brown areas indicate sparse vegetation or bare soil. No scale bar, compass, or specific geographic location is indicated on the image.
